sets.name: Saint's Winding
sets.summary: Chalk-white glazed clay, folded linen, silver stitching and soft pearl.
sets.direction: A healer's vestments given physical form: chalk-white glazed clay rails wrapped in layered ivory linen, subtle cool gray linen shadows, fine silver stitching, tiny pale pearl anchors. Very little metal, absolutely no plate armor, no gold outline. Broad folded linen hems form thin coherent borders, visibly soft and tactile but supported by narrow glazed ceramic bones beneath. Minimap a glazed white hoop with linen wrapped asymmetrically around three joins; action banks tightly folded cloth-and-ceramic eyelets with open gaps between them, no backing slab. Unitframes have layered clean bandage/vestment rims and straight ceramic rails, small folded cloth ends outside portrait rims only. Castbar a long folded hem over a fine ceramic rib. Arcs elegant narrow ceramic curves with flowing linen folds along the outside, channels clear. Five center ornaments are five standalone little pearly teardrop reliquaries held by tiny linen knots, painted solid centers, not empty rings, optional ward graphics. Menu sigils are spare silver stitch marks, not all chevrons. A feeling of mercy, quiet healing and spirit-healer presence without literal angel wings or halos floating as scenery. NO brass, steel armor, crosses, skulls, elaborate filigree, ornate church architecture or magical glow clouds.
sets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: usable modular 2D fantasy MMORPG HUD texture sheet for WoW. Square high resolution 2048px or larger. Input image 1 is a GEOMETRY GUIDE ONLY. Replace gray placeholder structure with painted art. Keep its component positions, separate pieces, relative proportions and open holes. ALL off-white apertures and ALL background must become real alpha-zero transparency, not black paint.
Fixed components: Top third, cohesive low-wing minimap/action chassis: one circular empty map aperture and exactly 32 matching round empty button holes, sixteen per side. Per side six primary sockets (four horizontal, two climbing beside map), and ten utility sockets below in two rows of five. Keep top of map clear. Three banks look unified but have natural material seams allowing independent fading. Thin rails around holes, no solid rectangular backing. Middle, two separate matching mirrored unitframe casings, circular portrait hole at outer end plus one long clear health channel and a narrower power channel. Below, one separate slender horizontal cast casing with clear straight channel and decorated endcaps, aspect ratio roughly 10:1. Bottom corners, paired tall inward-opening curved resource casings '(' left and ')' right, clear uninterrupted curved channels. Bottom center, five standalone small class-indicator ornaments in a row, two small empty circular buff reminder casings below, and seven tiny standalone scratched menu glyphs below those, no menu background.
Painted sculpted Warcraft-style interface art. Strong practical silhouettes, broad tactile worn material planes, restrained medium detail, readable at 34px buttons and 220px tall arcs. Race/spec affect construction and silhouette as much as palette. Clear transparent gutters between components, nothing clipped at canvas edge. Narrow material joins keep each component physically cohesive.
NO screenshot, scene, fake game interface, characters, portraits, maps, icons, spell images, painted resource fills, text, numbers, labels, captions, logos, checkerboard, opaque backing, vignette, ground shadow or glow haze. No ornament crosses functional openings. Do not fill ring centers with illustrations. Not photoreal macro photography, not mobile game plastic, not gold filigree noise. Output only isolated real transparent art.

sets.name: Scarlet Confession
sets.summary: Crimson wax, scorched prayer parchment, soot-black iron and severe ivory seals.
sets.direction: A severe fanatical priest's devotional equipment, not a paladin shield: soot-black thin iron staples and rails, overlapping scorched prayer parchment strips with NO legible writing, heavy deep crimson sealing wax collected only at structural joins, occasional plain ivory stamped sunburst medallions. Minimap ring looks like a black iron devotional hoop bound in old parchment and red wax, bottom a small stern sunburst seal. Button rails narrow paper-wrapped iron, red wax structural clamps, empty circular openings. Unitframes straight folded parchment layers with severe iron portrait rims and small wax seals, no silver swords. Cast rail is taut rolled parchment between iron prayer clamps, with small solid cooled wax beads. Arcs thin soot iron ribs with sparse paper wraps and red wax joints. Five central sprites are five solid pressed crimson wax seal tokens with one simple unlettered sunburst impression, not empty rings; optional buff/reminder artwork. Menu glyphs simple etched confessional tally sigils, no letters or numbers, no seven identical chevrons. Stark bone-white, dirty cream, black and blood-crimson. Austere oppressive ritual, no gore, no huge wings, no giant candles, no flames or smoke background, no gilded filigree.

sets.name: Black Benediction
sets.summary: Ink-black smoked glass, pale hairline fractures and restrained violet underlight.
sets.direction: Unsettling Shadow priest ritual art with a new silhouette: thin smooth liquid-looking ink-black smoked-glass borders reinforced by rough obsidian at just a few seams. Pale cool-gray hairline cracks, subtle dark violet light sealed within the glass recesses, narrow translucent tendril-like glass curls tucked along the edges, not a chaos of tentacles. Negative space matters, inner rim seems to drink light but remains physically clear. Map smooth dark glass hoop with an asymmetrical obsidian clasp, action banks lean open glass rails with no opaque backing panel. Unitframes long austere dark-glass channels with sharp pale fracture edges, outer portrait rim slightly unbalanced sculptural obsidian shape, circular window still exact. Cast bar a narrow dark lens rail. Arcs sinuous dark glass crescent casings with clean empty fill channels and pale thin crack highlights. Five center sprites are five solid tiny sealed black-glass reliquary shards containing a dark violet ink droplet; optional ward state ornaments, NOT an Insanity or combo mechanic. Seven menu sigils irregular thin fracture marks, not chevrons. Clinical psychic dread, no skulls, eyeballs, faces, mouths, readable runes, large claws, purple clouds, galaxies, glowing portals, star fields, gold trim or metal armor.

sets.name: Balance of Contrition
sets.inspiration: Discipline / light and shadow held in tension
sets.summary: Paired ivory and charcoal ceramic, copper sutures and restrained amber/violet accents.
sets.direction: A Discipline priest's visibly balanced ritual instrument: paired off-white ivory ceramic and matte charcoal ceramic halves, joined by extremely thin old copper sutures and understated braided silver wire. One half is light, one dark, materials meet in clear complementary seam patterns rather than a simple recolor. The minimap ring has opposing ivory and charcoal semicircles with small copper joints at top/bottom, WITHOUT literal yin-yang or recognizable real religious icons. Each button bank alternates sparse ivory and dark ceramic structural bridges around empty eyelets. Player and target are matched mirrored ceremonial instruments, each includes both material halves, straight open bar rails joined by copper stitches. Castbar long rail meeting light/dark at its exact center with a thin restrained joint. HUD arcs one predominantly ivory, one predominantly charcoal, with shared copper construction and empty channels. Five small central solid lenticular prayer tokens, each half ivory and half charcoal, simple balanced seam and tiny sealed amber/violet inset, optional buff/ward art. Menu marks paired short copper incisions forming different sigils. Calm severe self-discipline, asymmetry controlled, no armor spikes, wings, chains across holes, ornate gold, neon or background atmosphere.

sets.name: Light in the Trenches
sets.inspiration: Human or dwarf / veteran field priest
sets.summary: Weathered canvas, iron wire, worn leather, fresh linen and clear holy-water glass.
sets.direction: A practical battlefield healer's portable devotional kit, visibly soft and used, not armor: olive-gray weathered canvas strips, dark brown worn leather reinforcement tabs, sparse bent black iron wire eyelets, fresh off-white linen repair wraps and tiny clear holy-water glass beads at only a few clasps. Small plain incised pale sunburst clasp, no red-cross logos. Thin folded canvas hem construction makes the action wings and unitframe rails, ragged outer edges kept short and useful, all live windows clear. Map simple dark wire hoop wrapped in canvas and clean linen, no compass painted in. Sockets individual wire eyelets joined by narrow canvas strips with NO solid opaque backdrop. Unitframe portrait rims wire/leather bindings, straight stitched canvas rails, visibly repaired. Castbar a taut linen-bound iron rod with small clear water-bead endcaps. Arcs bent dark wire in close canvas sleeves, narrow uninterrupted empty channels. Five central sprites are five solid small clear holy-water ampoule charms in linen sleeves, water colorless with restrained pale highlights, not poison green; optional buff/reminder ornaments. Menu sigils seven spare distinct needle-and-thread scratch forms, not identical chevrons. Grounded veteran compassion, ash, mud and careful maintenance, no gore, no medical scene, no swords, plate armor, gold scrollwork or huge religious symbols.
